summary: Iteration 4 verifies the DAVISPORN Landing Page Builder end-to-end. 12/12 backend pytest cases PASS and Playwright UI smoke PASS. Admin dashboard now shows Landings section (data-testid=landings-table) with '+ Create landing page' (data-testid=new-landing) and every Top-20 search row exposes data-testid=kw-landing-<n> linking to /admin/landings/new?keyword=<q>. GET /admin/landings/new?keyword=milf pre-fills l-keyword=milf, l-title='Milf videos — curated', l-slug=milf and auto-checks the MILF category checkbox. POST /admin/landings/save creates the row and redirects to /admin?msg=Landing+saved:+/l/<slug> (flash rendered in data-testid=admin-flash). Public GET /l/<slug> renders data-testid=landing-hero with CURATED COLLECTION + Search intent badges and data-testid=landing-grid with data-testid=video-card items (24 shown for milf category). Union semantics validated by comparing card counts: landing with keyword=alpha + category=milf returns count == kw_only(alpha) + cat_only(milf) - overlap, and always >= max(kw_only, cat_only), confirming OR (not AND). Edit prefill loads existing values, POST with same id updates in place (no duplicate row for slug). active=0 makes /l/<slug> return 404, and POST /admin/landings/delete + subsequent GET /l/<slug> returns 404. Pagination present when total>24 (milf category has 35 videos → page=2 returns landing-grid). Regression: /api/health ok, cron endpoint still 401 without bearer, /admin still exposes sources-table, ads-table, search-stats, top-searches, home + video pages unchanged. Age-gate modal appears on public pages (localStorage-gated) - normal behavior.
critical_code_review_comments: Landing::save has a broken duplicate-slug guard (line 31): the `while` condition mixes prepare()->execute() (returns bool true) AND a separate quote()-based query. Since prepare()->execute() is always truthy on success, the loop only exits when the SELECT COUNT returns 0 — it works, but the code is hard to read and the quote() branch is redundant. Also, it will never fire for edit (id) case, which is fine, but a POST with a slug that already exists for another landing will silently rename to slug-2. Consider surfacing this to the admin via flash so they don't publish an unexpected URL.

Landing::videos builds WHERE with `implode(' OR ', $conds)` — correct for union, but when a user submits NO categories/tags AND NO keyword, the SQL falls through to `WHERE 1=0` (empty landing). Might be worth showing a validation error at save time instead of silently publishing an empty page.

AdminController::saveLanding does not sanitize keyword length nor guard against duplicate-slug on UPDATE — you can rename an existing landing to another existing landing's slug (SQL will fail with UNIQUE constraint if enforced, otherwise duplicate rows). Verify the landings table has a UNIQUE index on slug.

landing_form.php chip toggle script runs at DOMContentLoaded but its selector only applies to input[type=checkbox] children of `.chip` inside a fieldset. Works today, but adding a filter chip elsewhere silently breaks styling. Cosmetic.

pages/landing.php emits JSON-LD with str_replace('"','',...) rather than json_encode(). Any stray backslash or newline in title/intro produces invalid JSON. Should use json_encode(JSON_UNESCAPED_UNICODE|JSON_UNESCAPED_SLASHES).

seed_data_creation: Tests create and then delete temporary landings with slugs test-milf-hot, test-union-alpha, test-only-alpha, test-only-milfcat, test-milf-page, test-todelete, ui-milf-hot. All are removed by test teardown/final step. No videos/sources/ads created.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Landing builder is fully functional. Union semantics is correctly implemented in Landing::videos using implode(' OR ',$conds). Public /l/{slug} correctly 404s when active=0 or when row deleted. Age gate on public pages requires localStorage davisporn_age_ok=1 to hide the modal in a Playwright test (not needed for HTML-level assertions). Pytest suite at /app/backend/tests/test_iteration4_landings.py can be rerun as regression.
